faq_heading: Homes near Ray Shepherd Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Ray Shepherd Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Ray Shepherd Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Ray Shepherd Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Ray Shepherd Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 57 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,535,000, condos $528,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Ray Shepherd Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Ray Shepherd Elementary the median was 37 days on the market, closing at 94.3% of the list price, with 2% of sales above the list price for the 57 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Ray Shepherd Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Laronde Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Bayridge Elementary (1.2 km east) and Elgin Park Secondary (1.5 km north).

Ray Shepherd Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 1650 136 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Ray Shepherd Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Ray Shepherd Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Ray Shepherd Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Ray Shepherd Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 57 homes sold within 1 km of Ray Shepherd Elementary: 42 houses, 4 townhomes and 7 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,535,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Ray Shepherd Elementary

8 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Ray Shepherd Elementary in a straight line (6 elementary, 2 secondary; 0 independent). The closest is Laronde Elementary, 1.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Semiahmoo Secondary, 2.4 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Elgin Park Secondary (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Laronde Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Bayridge Elementary (1.2 km east), Chantrell Creek Elementary (1.8 km north), Ocean Cliff Elementary (2.3 km west), Crescent Park Elementary (2.3 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Laronde Elementary, 1.1 km north-west of Ray Shepherd Elementary.
